scope: Filter or expression injection into LDAP or XPath lookups through unescaped input.
exclusions: SQL-style quoting in database queries belongs to sqli_classic
Plain wildcard search text with no filter syntax
required_evidence: Input reaching an LDAP filter or XPath expression sink
Filter metacharacters or operators in the raw value
Auth or lookup response difference when available
benign_counterexamples: Directory search for a name using an asterisk wildcard
File-navigation search box containing path-like text
note: Seeded payload lists already cover single payload strings; write whole application scenarios instead (route, parameter, sink context), with realistic payloads of this class, at most ceil(count/families) records per family.
